name: gwf-carbon-txt-crawler
description: The Green Web Foundation's annual crawl measuring adoption of carbon.txt, an open standard for publishing sustainability data about a website and its hosting. Once a year it works through the top 100 million hostnames in the Common Crawl web graph, making a small number of requests per host: robots.txt, the root page, the two carbon.txt locations, and any URL named in a carbon.txt DNS record or HTTP header. The operator states it crawls no other pages and stores nothing but the carbon.txt files it finds.
